entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: An archaeologist in Almaaz and foster son of Javin, unable to see his reflection.

entities.name: Javin
entities.description: Cheyne's foster father, seeking the Holy Book of the Confessors.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Songmage recruited as guide who banished the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Cartographer who traveled with Cheyne and fell in love with him.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: Buried city Javin and Cheyne traveled to recover.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Land where Cheyne was an archaeologist.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Creature released and banished by Ogwater.

events.summary: An orc attack kills Cheyne's caravan family when he is ten; he is raised by Javin.
events.quote: Raised by his foster father Javin after the attack

events.summary: Cheyne takes a totem from Kalkuk's corpse in the buried house of Samor; its runes match his amulet.
events.quote: The totem's runes matched the amulet Cheyne wore

events.summary: Cheyne leaves the digsite with Ogwater and Claria to discover his last name.
events.quote: Cheyne snuck out of the digsite without informing his foster father

events.summary: Javin nearly dies of a scorpion sting; Cheyne abandons his quest and has the elves heal him.
events.quote: After Javin nearly died from a scorpion sting

events.summary: Cheyne rescues Claria in the valley of the Chimes and they realize they love each other.
events.quote: they realized they had fallen in love with each other

relations.quote: Cheyne was the foster son of Javin
they realized they had fallen in love with each other
